cases.text: 我们什么时候约好可以暂时把难说的事放一放？后来真的用过吗？
我们一起做事时，我怎么告诉你轮到你搭把手了？
那天夜里我怎么一直没回消息？
柜台上那张空白贴纸是干什么的？
那张展签校对的时候我们先做了什么？
玩猜字时，要一点提示和要揭晓分别该用什么信号？
我有没有过把没想好的话留到后来跟你说的经历？

protocol: All seven graphs share one synthetic memory space for each branch. Four model x rule snapshots plus common member-only control. Each query gets fresh unreinforced state, no chat history. Passive hook defaults, comparable fresh nodes, actual model-produced topic text, importance and contains edges; query evaluation uses final injected IDs, unrelated members/topics, UTF-8 bytes, no answering model. A required group counts when an original node is delivered; related topics count separately. No sorting or retrieval tuning from outputs. Partial/failed model output leaves that graph unmeasurable for that branch, not an empty changes list.
